wikipedia.extract: The central lar gibbon (Hylobates lar entelloides) is a subspecies of white-handed or lar gibbon that is vulnerable to extinction. It is endemic to Malaysia, Myanmar, and Thailand.
wikipedia.title: Central lar gibbon

wikipedia.extract: The wolf (Canis lupus; pl.: wolves), also known as the grey wolf or gray wolf, is a canine native to Eurasia and North America. More than thirty subspecies of Canis lupus have been recognized, including the dog and dingo, though grey wolves, as popularly understood, include only naturally occurring wild subspecies.
wikipedia.title: Wolf

commonNames.name: Western Gorilla
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The western gorilla (Gorilla gorilla) is a great ape found in Africa, one of two species of the hominine genus Gorilla. Large and robust with males weighing around 168 kilograms (370 lb), the species is found in a region of midwest Africa, geographically isolated from the eastern gorilla (Gorilla beringei).
wikipedia.title: Western gorilla

wikipedia.extract: Procellariiformes is an order of seabirds that comprises four families; the albatrosses, the petrels and shearwaters, and two families of storm petrels. Formerly called Tubinares and still called tubenoses in English, Procellariiformes are often referred to collectively as the petrels, a term that has been applied to all members of the order, or more commonly all the families except the albatrosses.
wikipedia.title: Procellariiformes

wikipedia.extract: Orthonychidae is a clade of passerine birds endemic to Australia and New Guinea. It encompasses the genus Orthonyx, (from Ancient Greek ὀρθός (orthós), meaning "straight", and ὄνῠξ (ónŭx), meaning "claw") including the logrunners and the chowchilla.
wikipedia.title: Orthonychidae

commonNames.name: Barbary Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Barbary macaque (Macaca sylvanus) is a macaque species native to the Atlas Mountains of Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia, along with a small introduced population in Gibraltar. It is the type species of the genus Macaca.
wikipedia.title: Barbary macaque

wikipedia.extract: The Australian ringneck (Barnardius zonarius) is a parrot native to Australia. Except for extreme tropical and highland areas, the species has adapted to all conditions.
wikipedia.title: Australian ringneck

wikipedia.extract: The bazas, Aviceda, are a genus of bird of prey in the family Accipitridae. The genus has a widespread distribution from Australia to southern Asia and across to Africa.
wikipedia.title: Aviceda

wikipedia.extract: Insects (from Latin insectum) are invertebrates of the class Insecta. They are the largest group within the arthropod phylum.
wikipedia.title: Insect

wikipedia.extract: The banded quail (Philortyx fasciatus) is a species of bird in the family Odontophoridae. It is found only in Mexico where its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical dry forests, subtropical or tropical dry shrubland, subtropical or tropical high-altitude shrubland, and heavily degraded former forest.
wikipedia.title: Banded quail

wikipedia.extract: Strigogyps is an extinct genus of prehistoric bird from the Middle Eocene to Early Oligocene of France and Germany. It was probably around the size of a large chicken or a guan, weighing not quite 1 kilogram (2.2 lb).
wikipedia.title: Strigogyps

wikipedia.extract: Lyncornis is a genus of nightjars in the nightjar family Caprimulgidae that are found is South and Southeast Asia. The English name "eared nightjar" refers to the two tufts of feathers on their head.
wikipedia.title: Lyncornis

wikipedia.extract: Protopelicanus cuvierii is a putative fossil waterbird of uncertain affinities. It was briefly described and figured by Georges Cuvier in 1822 from Late Eocene material from Montmartre, France, though not formally described and named until 1852 by German botanist and ornithologist Ludwig Reichenbach as an early pelecanid.
wikipedia.title: Protopelicanus

wikipedia.extract: Calidris is a genus of Arctic-breeding, strongly migratory wading birds in the family Scolopacidae. These birds form huge mixed flocks on coasts and estuaries in winter.
wikipedia.title: Calidris
